change_summary: Added a runtime-only overlay-budget runner. Macro entry logic is unchanged from exp-20260425-005. A+B signals keep priority; at most one macro signal is appended after A+B; experiment config temporarily expands MAX_POSITIONS by one only for overlay variants; macro sizing is reduced to 0.25x or 0.5x after normal sizing. No production trading code was promoted.
component: runtime-only `quant/experiments/legacy/exp_20260425_007_runner.py`, monkeypatching `signal_engine.generate_signals()` and `portfolio_engine.size_signals()` only during measurement

delta_metrics.note: The overlay shape reduced trade count and exposure versus v1 but did not solve stability. 0.25x still regressed all three windows. 0.5x produced only a tiny old_thin EV gain (+0.0013) while materially damaging late_strong and mid_weak.

hypothesis: The macro defensive sleeve may have failed because it was forced to compete with A+B for main slots. Keeping A+B priority while adding at most one reduced-risk macro overlay position should preserve old_thin's macro benefit with less late/mid damage.

market_regime_summary.late_strong: slow-melt bull / accepted A+B stack dominant tape
market_regime_summary.mid_weak: rotation-heavy bull where macro overlay remained a drag
market_regime_summary.old_thin: mixed-to-weak macro tape where 0.5x overlay had only tiny net benefit

next_retry_requires: Do not retry the same macro entry recipe merely with another small risk multiplier or one-slot overlay shape
Do not interpret prior v1 old_thin improvement as proof that slot competition was the main failure mode
If macro alpha continues, change the information source to explicit cross-asset context such as GLD/SLV/commodity ETF leadership, rates/dollar proxies, or event/macro news context
Alternatively pause macro and return to another independent alpha class rather than overfitting this defensive-stock continuation recipe
notes: Production entry, exit, sizing rules, accepted residual cohort haircuts, C strategy, and LLM responsibilities stayed unchanged. This was an allocation-shape test, not a new macro entry or gate test.

allocation_shape.limitation: existing backtester has no native separate slot ledger; this is an expanded-spare-slot approximation, not a full production overlay engine
allocation_shape.overlay_budget: at most one macro signal appended after A+B
allocation_shape.slot_model: MAX_POSITIONS temporarily expanded by 1 for overlay variants

parameters.entry_recipe: same as exp-20260425-005: defensive sectors, index pressure, above_200ma, positive 10d momentum, relative strength vs SPY, trend_score >= 0.55, not within 3 days of earnings

rejection_reason: Rejected on Gate 4 multi-window stability. A separate reduced-risk overlay does not make the current OHLCV-only macro defensive entry robust: late_strong and mid_weak still suffer, while old_thin improvement is absent at 0.25x and negligible at 0.5x.
